predicate.label: criticized or accused
predicate.definition: Person or institution X criticized, blamed or accused Y.
ambiguous: unclear accused person or attributed critic
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit criticize/blame/accuse/assail; a clearly critical directed allegation. Excludes: warning without criticism; generic communication or meeting; rivalry/comparison alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear accused person or attributed critic.

rationale: Accusation and criticism dominate; numerical outnumbering and cooperation do not entail criticism.
